name: Acolyte
description: Devoted to a temple or deity, learning divine rituals and faith.

name: Artisan
description: Apprenticed in a trade, creating crafts and managing business.

name: Charlatan
description: A master of manipulation and deception, seeking out marks in taverns and markets.

name: Criminal
description: Experienced in surviving outside the law and navigating the urban underbelly.

name: Entertainer
description: Thrives on performance and showmanship to captivate and inspire audiences.

name: Farmer
description: Cultivated the land and tended animals, gaining a deep respect for nature.

name: Guard
description: Spent time standing watch, trained to spot danger and protect city gates.

name: Guide
description: Explored the outdoors and natural wilderness, channeling primal magic.

name: Hermit
description: Lived in solitude outside society, contemplating creation and spiritual arts.

name: Merchant
description: Traded goods and managed commerce, possessing keen business instincts.

name: Noble
description: Raised in high society, well-versed in diplomacy, history, and courtly customs.

name: Sage
description: Studied in great libraries and archives, learning magic and historical lore.

name: Sailor
description: Called the open water home, surviving harsh storms and rough harbor life.

name: Scribe
description: Focused on copying texts and documents with a finely honed eye for detail.

name: Soldier
description: Trained in battle and warfare, built on physical strength and combat experience.

name: Wayfarer
description: Wandered street corners or distant roads, relying on stealth, insight, and luck.

name: Chondathan Freebooter
description: A privateer and rover hailing from the waterways and forests of Chondath.

name: Dead Magic Dweller
description: Accustomed to surviving in desolate zones where magic fails or behaves wildly.

name: Dragon Cultist
description: Infiltrated or served within secretive cults dedicated to draconic overlords.

name: Emerald Enclave Caretaker
description: Sworn to protect wild sanctuaries and preserve natural harmony.

name: Flaming Fist Mercenary
description: A battle-tested veteran of Baldur's Gate's fierce mercenary company.

name: Genie Touched
description: Marked by planar energy or ancestral pacts with elemental genies.

name: Harper
description: A covert agent dedicated to thwarting tyranny and safeguarding secret lore.

name: Ice Fisher
description: A hardened survivalist from frozen northern lakes and icy mountain wastes.

name: Knight of the Gauntlet
description: A holy warrior aligned with the Order of the Gauntlet to root out evil.

name: Lords' Alliance Vassal
description: A diplomatic representative working to maintain harmony between allied city-states.

name: Moonwell Pilgrim
description: Bound to the mystical waters and natural guardian spirits of the Moonshae Isles.

name: Mulhorandi Tomb Raider
description: An adventurer who braves ancient desert tombs and crypts in search of ancient relics.

name: Mythalkeeper
description: A scholar dedicated to studying, maintaining, and protecting ancient high-elven mythals.

name: Purple Dragon Squire
description: Trained in the honorable martial traditions and knightly discipline of Cormyr.

name: Rashemi Wanderer
description: A tough traveler steeped in the ancestral spirit magic and rugged traditions of Rashemen.

name: Shadowmasters Exile
description: A rogue or survivor on the run from Telflamme's notorious shadow guild.

name: Zhentarim Mercenary
description: An operative connected to the Black Network, balancing ruthlessness and profit.

name: Amnesiac
description: Awakened with lost memories, slowly piecing together a mysterious past.

name: Crimson Aspirant
description: Studied forbidden hemomancy and the vitality-manipulating arts of blood.

name: Crossroads Gambler
description: Pledged a midnight wager at a lonely crossroads and walked away alive.

name: Cultist
description: Indoctrinated into dark rites and sworn to the service of eldritch entities.

name: Druskenvald Dweller
description: A native to the horror-ridden lands of Druskenvald, attuned to local dangers.

name: Experiment
description: Physically transformed by strange alchemy, arcane science, or monstrous influence.

name: Ghostlight Passenger
description: Rode the phantom Ghostlight Express, forming a link with departed souls.

name: Night Stalker
description: Stalks creatures of darkness in misty woods and shadowed ruins.

name: Reflected Wanderer
description: Separated from your own shadow or mirror image, living a fractured life.

name: Rest Warden
description: A gravedigger or undertaker who ensures the dead stay peacefully buried.

name: Reveler
description: A traveler of wild nocturnal festivals and eerie, forgotten carnivals.

name: Scholar of the Forbidden
description: Uncovered taboo occult texts and lore that traditional academies shun.

name: Wicker Weaver
description: Crafts effigies, pagan icons, and wicker talismans to ward off dark spirits.

name: Beast Hunter
description: Tracks down terrifying beasts and nocturnal threats in grim lands.

name: Disinherited Noble
description: Stripped of title, land, and wealth, driven to reclaim lost birthrights.

name: Expelled Academy Member
description: Cast out from magical institutions for pursuing dangerous or unethical research.

name: Free Enterprise Infiltrator
description: Navigates corporate cartels, crime syndicates, and black-market intrigue.

name: Inquisitor Apprentice
description: Trained under zealous inquisitors to purge heresy and demonic taint.

name: Pox Doctor
description: Treats plague victims and handles morbid afflictions using grim medical methods.

name: Carouser
description: Grew up in the heart of a large city, navigating taverns, parlors, and high-stakes social circles.

name: Vampire Devotee
description: Served in a lair of vampires, repeatedly fed upon as a familiar or aspiring undead.

name: Vampire Survivor
description: Lived through a horrific vampire encounter, keeping a vigilant watch against monster attacks.

name: Lorwyn Expert
description: Hails from Lorwyn or studied its eternal sunshine, embarking on whimsical adventures and holding loved ones close.

name: Shadowmoor Expert
description: Survives or studies the gloomy, moonlight-lit realm of Shadowmoor using wit, cunning, or brawn while carefully choosing whom to trust.

name: Haunted One
description: Bears the unshakable, painful weight of past tragic events that cannot be buried, slain, or banished.

name: Investigator
description: Relentlessly seeks truth and unravels local crimes or eldritch conspiracies others wish to keep hidden.

name: Mist Wanderer
description: Drawn by the Mists into a Domain of Dread, wandering between cursed realms in search of a way home.

name: Spirit Medium
description: Serves as a conduit for spirits of the dead and damned, drawing prescient insight that comes at a haunting cost.
